sentence: The knight showed great _____ in battle.
explanation: VALIANT → valiance (forma sustantiva arcaica que significa 'gran valentía o coraje')

sentence: The _____ of the old castle gave it a mysterious atmosphere.
explanation: HOARY → hoariness (literario: cualidad de ser antiguo y canoso)

sentence: She spoke with great _____ about the injustice she had witnessed.
explanation: ELOQUENT → eloquence (cambia -t por -ce para formar un sustantivo que significa 'expresión fluida y elocuente')

sentence: The _____ of the monarch was celebrated throughout the kingdom.
explanation: BENEVOLENT → benevolence (cambia -t por -ce para formar un sustantivo que significa 'bondad')

sentence: His _____ nature made him unsuitable for the harsh realities of politics.
explanation: GUILELESS → guilelessness (añade -ness para formar un sustantivo que significa 'sinceridad inocente')

sentence: The poet's _____ verse captured the beauty of the natural world.
explanation: LYRIC → lyrical (añade -al para formar un adjetivo que significa 'que expresa emoción de forma bella')

sentence: The _____ of the ancient text made it difficult to decipher.
explanation: OBSCURE → obscurity (cambia -e por -ity para formar un sustantivo que significa 'estado de ser poco claro')

sentence: The _____ of the old manuscript was evident in its faded ink.
explanation: ANTIQUE → antiquity (cambia -e por -ity para formar un sustantivo que significa 'gran antigüedad')

sentence: She displayed remarkable _____ in her dealings with foreign dignitaries.
explanation: MAGNANIMOUS → magnanimity (cambia -ous por -ity para formar un sustantivo que significa 'espíritu generoso')

sentence: The _____ of the landscape inspired many Romantic poets.
explanation: SUBLIME → sublimity (cambia -e por -ity para formar un sustantivo que significa 'grandeza sobrecogedora')

sentence: His _____ behaviour towards the servants was widely criticised.
explanation: TYRANT → tyrannical (cambia -t por -nical para formar un adjetivo que significa 'despótico')

sentence: The _____ of the philosopher's arguments was beyond question.
explanation: SAGACIOUS → sagacity (cambia -ous por -ity para formar un sustantivo que significa 'sabiduría aguda')

sentence: The _____ of the old cathedral filled visitors with awe.
explanation: RESPLENDENT → resplendence (cambia -t por -ce para formar un sustantivo que significa 'belleza deslumbrante')

sentence: Her _____ spirit could not be broken by adversity.
explanation: INDOMITABLE → indomitability (cambia -le por -lity para formar un sustantivo que significa 'espíritu invencible')

sentence: The _____ of the courtiers was evident in their elaborate dress.
explanation: OPULENT → opulence (cambia -t por -ce para formar un sustantivo que significa 'gran riqueza y lujo')

sentence: The _____ tone of the eulogy moved everyone to tears.
explanation: ELEGY → elegiac (cambia -y por -iac para formar un adjetivo que significa 'de tono poético y fúnebre')

sentence: His _____ wit made him the life of every literary salon.
explanation: MORDANT → mordancy (cambia -t por -cy para formar un sustantivo que significa 'cualidad mordaz e incisiva')

sentence: The _____ of the ancient ruins spoke of a once-great civilisation.
explanation: DESOLATE → desolation (cambia -e por -ion para formar un sustantivo que significa 'vacío desolador')

sentence: She wrote with a _____ clarity that illuminated even the most complex ideas.
explanation: LUCID → lucidity (añade -ity para formar un sustantivo que significa 'claridad de pensamiento')

sentence: The _____ of the old regime was finally overthrown.
explanation: DESPOTIC → despotism (cambia -ic por -ism para formar un sustantivo que significa 'gobierno tiránico')
